content:
Context: 1. Income from Salary

We are dealing with (1) and (2) only.  
Tax deduction at source.Every employer should deduct income tax at source in monthly instalments on the salaries disbursed by him, final adjustment being made from the last salary payable before the end of March. For this purpose, the employer has to take into account only the income under "Salaries" excepting cases where additional income is permitted to be taken into account, like income from house property.
